A '''drag course''' used for [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] existed on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The track featured an array of twists and turns, and offered obstacles such as rough terrain where [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]] would lose traction and slow down considerably. Other obstacles included large rocks and turns within canyons with hard cliff-sides on either side of the road. The [[Nuknog/Legends|Nuknog]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ark Roose/Legends|Ark Roose]], sometimes called Ark "Bumpy" Roose, was favored here. Roose would challenge other racers to one-on-one matches.<ref name="EiR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The course first appeared, unnamed, in the [[1999]] [[Wikipedia:Nintendo Game Boy|Gameboy Color]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]''.<ref name="EiR" />
